page.about.title: Engineering Excellence in Software Development
page.about.paragraph: I am a Senior Software Engineer based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with over 9 years of hands-on expertise in IT and enterprise software development. While my academic degree is in Telecommunication & Electronics Engineering, my entire professional career is dedicated to software engineering — architecting and delivering high-scale web platforms, mobile apps, and robust digital systems. Deeply specialized in TypeScript, React, Next.js, Angular, React Native, and Node.js, I build clean, high-performance software architectures that accelerate digital transformation and deliver measurable business impact.
